[[Thierry Henry]]{{cite web |url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/De-cbs-au-ballon-d-or-thierry-henry-sera-maitre-de-ceremonie-au-cote-de-kate-scott/1736959 |title=De CBS au Ballon d'Or : Thierry Henry sera maître de cérémonie au côté de Kate Scott |date=19 October 2026 |publisher=[[L'Équipe]] |language=fr |access-date=23 October 2026 }} | winner = | website = {{URL|ballondor.com}} | previous = [[2025 Ballon d'Or|2025]] | main = [[Ballon d'Or]] | next = [[2027 Ballon d'Or|2027]] }} The '''2026 Ballon d'Or''' ({{lit|'''2026 Golden Ball'''}}) will be the 70th annual ceremony of the [[Ballon d'Or]], presented by ''[[France Football]]'', recognising the best footballers in the world in the 2025–26 season. For the fifth time in the history of the award, it will be given based on the results of the season instead of the calendar year. This is the period from 3 August 2025 to 19 July 2026.{{cite web |url=https://ballondor.com/news/posts/check-all-the-criteria-and-full-regulations-to-understand-ballon-dor-2026-trophy |title=Check all the Criteria and Full Regulations to understand Ballon d'Or 2026 trophy |website=ballondor.com |access-date=8 September 2026 |date=7 September 2026 |archive-date=8 September 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260908083434/https://ballondor.com/news/posts/check-all-the-criteria-and-full-regulations-to-understand-ballon-dor-2026-trophy |url-status=live }} The ceremony will take place on 26 October 2026 at the [[London Palladium]] in [[London]].{{cite magazine |last=Ross-Murray |first=Ewan |date=29 May 2026 |title=2026 Ballon d'Or Ceremony: History Made As Location, Details Revealed |url=https://www.si.com/soccer/2026-ballon-dor-ceremony-history-made-location-details-revealed |access-date=11 June 2026 |magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]] |issn=0038-822X |archive-date=30 May 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260530130651/https://www.si.com/soccer/2026-ballon-dor-ceremony-history-made-location-details-revealed |url-status=live}}{{cite web |title=2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony date and host city announced |url=https://www.uefa.com/ballondor/news/02a5-20bba5196317-e0e34001e13b-1000--2026-ballon-d-or-ceremony-date-and-host-city-announced/ |publisher=[[UEFA]] |access-date=11 June 2026 |date=28 May 2026 |archive-date=11 June 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260611073628/https://www.uefa.com/ballondor/news/02a5-20bba5196317-e0e34001e13b-1000--2026-ballon-d-or-ceremony-date-and-host-city-announced/ |url-status=live}} This also marks the first time the ceremony will be organised outside France. ==Ballon d'Or== {{Main|Ballon d'Or}} ''Club listed is the one which the player represented during the 2025–26 season.''
